text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for billing-metering: token-count oscillation in eu1 emitter stream. Metric: token_count_delta +12% over baseline in the last 30m. Possible duplication in emitter retries. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/billing/emit-dedupe 

sre-oncall - Jamie: Oncall Jamie here. Acked. Kicking off triage. Any immediate customer hits reported?

BillingEng - Priya: I'm seeing a step in token counts starting ~15:20 UTC. Embedding jobs show duplicate ack logs: `emitter: ack retry id=0x8f3 num_retries=3`. Suspect backoff/regain race with our retry handler.

eng-runtime - Aisha: Can you paste the log snippet? Also checking leader election churn on eu1. No pod restarts in last hour on serving.

BillingEng - Priya: log snippet: ```[2026-03-20T15:20:11Z] emitter WARN ack-retry id=0x8f3 state=sent retry=1
[2026-03-20T15:20:12Z] emitter WARN ack-retry id=0x8f3 state=sent retry=2
[2026-03-20T15:20:13Z] emitter INFO ack-confirm id=0x8f3```. Looks like duplicates then final ack - replays counted twice in aggregate.

data-metrics - Zoe: Confirmed: shadow-aggregate (daily) shows +11.8% vs expected for embed tokens. Spike correlates with emitter partition 7.

ops - Sean: If it's partition/consumer duplication, we should pause emitter writes for partition 7, flip to fallback route and reingest once deduped. Propose `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/emitter-p7-eu1` to drain.

ProductSupport - Marco: Heads up — two customers have gotten overage alert emails in the last 20m. Holding escalations, but they may call. Do not auto-bill until we confirm counts.

sre-oncall - Jamie: Agreed — halt billing alerts. @ops Sean can you pause emitter writes for p7? Also open a short-lived maintenance note on status.redwood.ai.

ops - Sean: Pausing emitter p7 now. Command: `kubectl patch deploy/emitter-p7-eu1 -p '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'` -> done. Emitting to fallback route (read-only) and started dedupe job.

incidents-bot: Action log: emitter partition 7 paused by Sean at 15:27 UTC. Dedup job kicked off.

BillingEng - Priya: Running dedupe against recent window (15:10-15:30). If we detect duplicate event ids we will subtract duplicates from counts and write corrected aggregates. ETA ~15-40.

data-metrics - Zoe: I ran a quick diff — estimated duplicate fraction ~9.6% in that window. Once dedup completes we'll recompute customer windows and mark charges as provisional.

ProductSupport - Marco: I'll draft customer-facing message and hold for confirm. Notifying top 5 affected accounts and pausing billing emails.

eng-runtime - Aisha: No cluster-level restarts. I instrumented a temporary metric on emitter-retry-backoff to monitor if retry loops are re-entering. Sending telemetry to dashboard.

sre-oncall - Jamie: Good. Current plan: (1) pause p7 (done), (2) dedupe window and recompute counts, (3) recompute invoices/notifications as provisional, (4) postmortem. Anyone see reason to escalate to P1?

BillingEng - Priya: Not P1 unless dedupe fails or more partitions show the same pattern.

ProductSupport - Marco: Filed a customer advisory draft in #support-drafts, pinging legal for wording.

incidents-bot: Update: dedupe job progress 40% (15:35 UTC).

data-metrics - Zoe: After partial dedupe, provisional aggregates down to +2.1% vs baseline. Looks like we caught most duplicates.

ops - Sean: Keeping p7 paused until we confirm stable. Will only unpause with explicit ack.

BillingEng - Priya: Dedupe finished at 15:44 UTC. Recomputed aggregates and wrote adjusted tokens to shadow ledger. Pushing corrected totals to billing pipeline now.

incidents-bot: Billing pipeline ingest accepted corrected totals at 15:45 UTC. No new overage emails sent.

ProductSupport - Marco: Notifying impacted customers with explanation + remediation ETA. Draft posted.

sre-oncall - Jamie: Great work. Leaving follow-ups: fix retry dedupe logic, add emitted-event idempotency check, run a canary for partition restarts. Scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

eng-runtime - Aisha: I'll open a PR for idempotency middleware and a small test harness for emitter replay scenarios.

BillingEng - Priya: Will add monitoring alert to detect >5% token deviation in 10m windows.

incidents-bot: Incident resolved to monitor. Severity downgraded. Postmortem: https://redwood.incidents/1755009877/postmortem
